verdict.rationale: Paperspace publishes its own API reference, generated from a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, with per-endpoint copyable cURL examples. However, the reference is explicitly static with no in-page runner, so the 'interactive' part of the story is not delivered and examples must be run outside the docs. missing for 10: interactive in-browser try-it/runner, in-page execution of examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: a static generated per-endpoint reference with copyable cURL examples (no in-page runner)
The DigitalOcean-hosted Paperspace API reference is generated from it.
